releases.title: Remove exercises during a workout
added: Remove an exercise and its sets from a workout using its options menu, with confirmation before removal.
changed: Find Substitute exercise alongside Remove exercise in each workout exercise’s options menu.
fixed: Remove either exercise from a linked pair while keeping its partner’s sets and entered values, without needing to fill in the removed exercise.
releases.playNotes: Remove an exercise during a workout from its options menu. Removing one half of a linked pair keeps the other exercise and its entered sets. Your routine stays unchanged unless you choose to update it when finishing. Substitute exercise is available in the same menu.

releases.title: Workout summaries and celebrations
added: Finish a workout with a full-screen summary of logged weight moved, elapsed time, completed sets and exercises.
Choose from five optional celebrations, shuffle your favorites, preview each effect, or turn them off in Settings.
changed: Keep partial sessions positive, respect the phone’s animation settings, and show how workout totals are calculated.
releases.playNotes: Finish workouts with a summary of weight moved, elapsed time, sets and exercises. Celebrate with confetti, fireworks, rings, bouncing plates or a dumbbell rocket. Choose your favorites, shuffle them, preview them or turn them off in Settings. Animations follow your phone’s animation settings.

releases.title: Clearer history and faster set logging
changed: Use the keyboard check mark in reps, seconds or distance to complete a valid set and advance to the next set.
fixed: Show how many additional completed exercises are hidden in each workout history preview.
releases.playNotes: Workout history now shows a count of additional completed exercises beyond the preview. Use the keyboard check mark in reps, seconds or distance to complete a valid set and move to the next one.

releases.title: Consistent website navigation
fixed: Keep the AI workout guide available in the header when opening terms, privacy and archived legal pages.
releases.playNotes: Keep website navigation consistent, including the AI workout guide on terms, privacy and archived legal pages.

releases.title: Seated cable and face-pull guides
added: Add four-step illustration previews for seated single-arm cable shoulder press and seated Pallof press.
Add Face pull with overhead raise as a separate exercise with an eight-step illustration guide.
fixed: Recognize these imported cable exercises with optional “(each side)” wording and spacing or hyphen variations, preserving saved names and history.
Update face-pull illustrations with an underhand grip, inward-facing palms, corrected rope paths, wider hands, shoulder-height elbows and an elbows-first return.
releases.playNotes: Add guides for imported seated cable shoulder presses and seated Pallof presses, including “(each side)” names. Update face-pull illustrations with an underhand grip, wide hands and an elbows-first return. Add Face pull with overhead raise as a separate exercise with eight illustrated steps.

releases.title: Reps, timed sets and distance carries
releases.playNotes: Choose reps, seconds or distance for each exercise. Set a default when creating an exercise and override it in a routine. New one-handed and two-handed Farmer’s Carry entries include illustration previews. Create importable routines with the AI guide and release-matched schema on becken.app.
added: Choose a default measurement when creating an exercise, then log only reps, seconds or distance for each routine entry.
One-handed and two-handed Farmer’s Carry entries have separate histories, distance defaults and illustration previews.
A public AI workout guide, downloadable import schema and example follow the shipped app through validated website updates.
changed: Timed and distance results support per-set history suggestions, feet/meters conversion and full backup/restore. Existing routines and workouts retain their rep-based values.

releases.title: Reliable saves and preserved drafts
changed: Save edits faster when workout history is large.
fixed: Prevent invalid workout edits from making saved data unreadable.
Reject backup exports above the restore limit before writing the destination file.
Keep exercise edits, routine suggestions, exercise pickers and browsing position during screen recreation.
releases.playNotes: Protect saved workouts from invalid edits and prevent backups that exceed the restore limit. Keep exercise edits, routine suggestions, pickers and browsing position during screen recreation. Save edits faster with large workout histories.

releases.title: Your training day names
changed: Show training day names exactly as entered, without automatic number prefixes in the routine list.
releases.playNotes: Training days now show your chosen names without automatic number prefixes in the routine list.

releases.title: Browse training days
added: View a training day’s exercises, sets, pairings and starting suggestions without starting a workout or editing the routine.
Open exercise illustration previews directly from the day browser.
releases.playNotes: Use View day to browse exercises, sets, pairings and starting suggestions before training. Open exercise illustration previews without starting a workout or editing your routine.

releases.title: Workout check reliability
fixed: Wait for saved workout changes to appear on screen in automated checks.
releases.playNotes: Maintenance update improving automated checks for workout editing.

releases.title: More reliable release checks
fixed: Prevent intermittent timeouts in automated workout checks before release.
releases.playNotes: Maintenance update improving the reliability of automated release checks.

releases.title: More reliable website changelog updates
fixed: Website changelog updates retry temporary GitHub errors before stopping.
releases.playNotes: Improved reliability of website changelog updates when GitHub is temporarily unavailable.

releases.title: Compact workout logging
added: Collapsible exercise sections and compact set rows.
Thin brackets show linked exercises while planning a routine.
changed: Only the current set opens for entry. Completing a set collapses it and opens the next set; tap any compact row to edit it.
Filled checkmarks and tinted rows distinguish completed sets from sets still to log.
releases.playNotes: Collapse exercise sections and keep upcoming and completed sets in compact rows. The current set opens for entry, then collapses when checked off. Tap any set to edit it. Thin brackets show linked exercises in the routine editor.

releases.title: Sweeteners during workouts
added: Enable or change sweeteners during a workout using a small icon beside each exercise.
changed: Only enabled sweetener fields appear in set rows, with separate amounts for every set.
releases.playNotes: Add or change eccentric, chains and inverse chains during a workout. Tap the small sparkle icon beside the exercise, then adjust the enabled values for each set.

releases.title: Consistent app and Play versions
changed: Play releases use the committed app version, with an automatically derived build code.
Every pull request prepares the next app version before merge.
releases.playNotes: App and Play releases share the same version. Build codes are assigned automatically so each update can be identified consistently.

releases.title: Illustration previews for every built-in exercise
added: Offline illustration previews for all 131 built-in exercises, with a generic human character, movement arrows and step-by-step captions.
Longer sequences for complex lifts, including the clean and press and Turkish get-up.
changed: Open the matching preview from the exercise library, exercise picker, routine day or workout, and enlarge the current step.
releases.playNotes: Illustration previews now cover all 131 built-in exercises. See a generic human character, movement arrows and step-by-step captions, with extra steps for complex lifts. Open a guide while choosing an exercise or during a workout. Every preview works offline and can be enlarged.

releases.title: Terms and exercise safety
added: An offline first-use agreement for the Terms of Service and Exercise Risk and Release.
Terms and safety in Settings, with saved agreement copies and an offline Privacy Policy.
Read, back up or delete existing training records when declining terms.
Safety guidance and links to exercise risks and terms beside exercise illustrations.
releases.playNotes: Review the Terms and Exercise Risk and Release before training. Read terms and privacy information offline in Settings, and save your accepted copy. Declining preserves access to existing records for reading, backup or deletion. Exercise illustrations include safety guidance and links to the terms.

releases.title: Exercise previews for Play testers
added: An offline flat push-up illustration preview in Play builds, with four steps, captions, movement arrows and an enlarged view. Open it from the exercise library, the picker, a routine day or a workout.
changed: Settings shows the build code beside the app version so testers can identify the installed update.
releases.playNotes: Preview the flat push-up in four illustrated steps, with captions, movement arrows and zoom. Open the guide while choosing an exercise or during a workout. The preview now works in Play testing builds. Settings also shows the build code beside the app version.

releases.title: Workout progress that stays in view
added: A public version history for Becken.
Incline (hands on bench) and decline (feet on bench) push-ups in the Chest exercise group.
Create an exercise from search results with the searched name already filled in, even when other exercises match.
changed: A compact progress bar and completed/total count stay in the header while you scroll through sets.
App messaging emphasizes free use, no subscription and fully offline training; optional cloud transfers need a connection.
fixed: Exercise search recognizes pushup, push-ups and push ups, including plural spellings.
Fixed release checks that blocked new Play testing builds.
releases.playNotes: Keep workout progress in view as you scroll: a tiny bar and completed/total count now appear beneath the workout title. Includes per-set sweetener logging and the Keep screen awake setting.

releases.title: Record resistance sweeteners
added: Choose eccentric, chains or inverse chains for each routine exercise, then record weight adjustments in each set.
Sweetener values carry forward from previous sets and are preserved in history and backups.
changed: Unit conversion and deloading include sweetener adjustments; existing saved data migrates automatically.
releases.playNotes: Choose eccentric, chains or inverse chains for routine exercises and record their weight adjustments per set. Previous results, deloading and backups preserve those details.

releases.title: Keep your workout on screen
added: An optional Settings toggle keeps the screen awake while Becken is in the foreground.
A dismissible tip introduces this setting after a few launches.
releases.playNotes: Keep the screen awake while Becken is open with a new optional setting and a dismissible startup tip.

releases.title: Prepare private Play testing
changed: Prepared the permanent Android app identity and release packaging for private Google Play testing.
Existing preview installations can transfer training data using manual backup and restore.
releases.playNotes: Prepared the permanent Android app identity and release packaging for private Google Play testing.

releases.title: The whole workout at a glance
added: A full-screen zoomable view of the routine → day → exercise → set → rep overview.
fixed: Restored the original single-picture overview to the welcome tour.
releases.playNotes: A full-screen zoomable view of the routine → day → exercise → set → rep overview.

releases.title: A welcome tour you can revisit
added: A welcome tour explains routines, days, exercises, sets, reps, imports and backups.
Replay the tour anytime from Settings.
releases.playNotes: A welcome tour explains routines, days, exercises, sets, reps, imports and backups.

releases.title: Meet Momentum
changed: Applied Becken’s Momentum branding to the launcher, startup screen, app header, Settings and light/dark palettes.
releases.playNotes: Applied Becken’s Momentum branding to the launcher, startup screen, app header, Settings and light/dark palettes.

releases.title: Lift Log becomes Becken
changed: Renamed the app to Becken and updated names for newly created backup files.
Existing training data and previously created Drive files keep their identities.
releases.playNotes: Renamed the app to Becken and updated names for newly created backup files.

releases.title: Prepare optional Drive backups
added: Implemented optional automatic Google Drive backups and account connection handling.
changed: Backups use one readable file, including unfinished workouts; restore keeps cloud uploads off until reconnected.
Drive integration requires deployment setup and remains disabled in default builds. Live Google authorization and upload testing were not verified for this version.
releases.playNotes: Implemented optional automatic Google Drive backups and account connection handling.

releases.title: Versioned data and migrations
added: Explicit schema versions for settings, exercise definitions, routines, workouts and editor drafts.
changed: Older saved data and backups migrate to the new formats while retaining history and unfinished edits.
Unsupported or damaged data is rejected without resetting the existing database.
releases.playNotes: Explicit schema versions for settings, exercise definitions, routines, workouts and editor drafts.

releases.title: A bigger, grouped exercise library
added: An expanded catalog of 129 exercises grouped by muscle group.
Drill into a group or search the exercise library; custom exercises can be assigned a group.
releases.playNotes: An expanded catalog of 129 exercises grouped by muscle group.

releases.title: A cleaner deload dialog
fixed: Fixed the deload dialog’s action layout when the reduction is set to 100%.
releases.playNotes: Fixed the deload dialog’s action layout when the reduction is set to 100%.

releases.title: Ease back in after a break
added: An optional deload after a configurable break from training, with a reduction slider in 5% steps.
A debug-only setting can simulate a training break.
changed: Tap weight and rep values to select them for replacement.
fixed: Improved numeric input visibility when the keyboard opens.
releases.playNotes: An optional deload after a configurable break from training, with a reduction slider in 5% steps.

releases.title: The first lifting log
added: Create named routines and reusable training days with exercises, sets, weight and reps.
Use previous per-set results, pair exercises, substitute movements and edit workout history.
Save unfinished workouts locally, import routines and save or restore readable backup files.
releases.playNotes: Create named routines and reusable training days with exercises, sets, weight and reps.
